prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Coloured full-body bestiary portrait, grounded hand-painted realistic game illustration. Broad readable brushwork, smooth light-to-shadow gradients across large forms, quiet surfaces with selective crisp detail at silhouette and focal features. No uniform high-frequency texture, craquelure, fractal cracks or sharpening noise. Soft upper-left light, muted natural colours. Empty dark charcoal subtly mottled backdrop, restrained contact shading only. Entire subject, feet, tails and tips inside comfortable margins. Portrait aspect about 4:5. No captions, symbols, border or circular crop. 
One large hulking wolf/human hybrid around 2.3m tall, stooped shoulders, powerful human-derived torso, TWO elongated arms ending in clawed hands and TWO digitigrade legs. Four limbs TOTAL. Long forearms hang beside knees but hands above ground in hunched biped stance. Elongated wolf muzzle, small pointed ears, coarse charcoal-grey and muted brown fur, short unremarkable tail. Watchful predator with slightly bared teeth, not head thrown back howling. Plain ragged dark shorts cover pelvis. Fur painted in broad grouped masses, selective coarse locks at edges, no fine noise everywhere. All hands and feet complete. No fantasy armour, sword, extra dorsal spikes, glowing eyes or equipment. Painting reference only.
